dict.string: Terse renders your agent windows (Claude, Codex, Cursor…) as a live particle field on the desktop. It reads only the windows you pick, and the pixels never leave this Mac.
Gesture Control lets you steer Terse's particles with your hands. Terse reads only hand joint positions from the camera, on this Mac — no video is recorded, stored or sent anywhere.
Talk to your Terse girlfriend by voice. The microphone is on only while you hold the mic button or keep conversation mode on; nothing is recorded or stored.
Terse turns what you say to your girlfriend into text — on this Mac where the language supports it — so your agent can answer.
